Once a beautiful world of lagoons and islands, over many centuries it became heavily-industrialized, until by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] it had become totally covered with toxic debris and had a poisonous surface as a result of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] and [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] dumping endless waste. ==Description== {{Quote|You don't realize how important a datapad is until you're stranded on Raxus Prime with nothing but your boots and a blaster.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|{{Tales|18|Revenants}}}} [[File:RaxusPrime1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An industrial building on Raxus Prime]] Raxus Prime was a highly industrial planet covered with immense factories, sealed living habitats, streams of superheated run-off water, rough-hewn quarry pits, vast debris fields, and toxic lakes. Most of the planet's residents lived in sealed environments near industrial facilities where they worked. Tunnels connected living areas with work bays, storage hangars and infrastructure units. While the planet was simply known as the garbage pit of the known Galaxy,{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|The Bounty of Raxus Prime}} it held many ancient secrets beneath its trash filled surface. One of which was the [[Force Harvester]], an ancient Sith artifact that was buried deep beneath the planet's surface until it was excavated by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]], who later used it to reactivate the [[Dark Reaper]], an ancient super weapon buried on the Sith world of [[Thule/Legends|Thule]] in an attempt to end the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The surface was covered with [[Monster droid/Legends|junk droids]] that were cobbled together from the parts of the millions of discarded and broken droids left there. They followed no master and did not behave by any rules, which made the planet very dangerous. A common rumor was that the droids were working on something large so that they could escape Raxus Prime and spread out into the galaxy at large.''[[Scavenger's Guide to Droids]]'' ==History== {{Dialogue|Windu|Obi-Wan, we want you to take a division of troops to Raxus Prime. We've received reports of Separatist activity in the system.|Kenobi|Raxus is a backwater planet of no strategic importance. What could the Separatists want with it?|Windu|That is what we want ''you'' to find out.|Yoda|On that planet, many ancient secrets, there are.|attr=[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|src=}} Once a beautiful planet within the [[Kingdom of Cron]], it served as one of the three capitals governing the kingdom. Warlord [[Xer VIII]] favored Raxus Prime, leaving it in his will to his concubines and their lovers. The seafloors of the warm lagoons were paved with colored tiles, while on the shores, large white-marble palaces were erected for those who inhabited the planet. After succeeding Xer, [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] continued the upkeep of the planet and built one of his palaces, deeming it the Circlet of the Tion. Later, when the pocket state of [[Nikato's Bootheel]] was erected around Raxus in [[14,300 BBY]], the [[Machinists of Nikato]] added elaborate clockwork mechanisms to the marble buildings, reflecting the galaxy's rotation. Soon, more and more corporations added their factories to Raxus Prime's surface, making it an important world in the Republic, known as Nikato's Shining Gem. Because of its new status as a hub of technology and manufacturing, it became a target during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. In [[3996 BBY]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] unleashed the [[Dark Reaper]] upon [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] troops there. In a mysterious and unexplained turn of fate, the machine was apparently disabled by Ulic before it could begin its devastation. It is here that the [[Force Harvester]], which was the power source for the Dark Reaper, would come to rest for several millennia. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], the planet became part of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]]. Throughout the [[Republic Dark Age|Dark Age of the Republic]] in [[1100 BBY/Legends|1100 BBY]], the factories of Raxus produced crude weapons, the [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] discharge stacks of which exuded black smog which soon engulfed the planet. The tiled lagoons filled with slag and the palaces were buried beneath scrap and debris from crashed ships. Whole continents of Raxus Prime began to be used as little more than junkyards for thousands of years. Because of this, a large portion of the planet's mass was actually alien metals. Old machinery, especially starships, often found their way to the planet.
[[File:RaxusPrime-EotEBtR.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The waste-covered surface of Raxus Prime]]
The [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] and the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] continued their operations here and simply dumped any waste out into the ruined environment. [[Aach Een]] and his parents moved to Raxus Prime from [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]]. Sometime prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Meeknu clan]] was transplanted there from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to work the machinery. Raxus Prime was a neighbor to [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]], the capital of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}} and served as [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] personal fortress. Dooku learned about the Harvester on Raxus Prime during his visit to Ulic Qel-Droma's tomb on [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]] shortly after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began. Dooku held [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] prisoner there for a period following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Jango Fett/Legends|his father]] in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. However, Boba quickly evaded Dooku and began his journey with the help of Aurra Sing to follow in his father's footsteps. Republic forces [[Conquest of Raxus Prime|attacked]] the planet in 22 BBY, but Dooku was able to escape with the Force Harvester and later used the device to [[Dark Reaper crisis|wreak havoc]] for a short time afterwards. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Galen Marek|secret apprentice]], codenamed Starkiller, [[First mission to Raxus Prime|visited]] the world in search of the reclusive Jedi Knight [[Kazdan Paratus]]. Paratus, who went into exile after escaping [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], had constructed a [[Junk Temple|makeshift Jedi Temple]] on Raxus Prime complete with robotic duplicates of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. After an intense duel, Starkiller defeated the deranged Jedi. [[File:Raxus_Prime_orbital_facility.jpg|thumb|left|220px|An Imperial orbital construction facility.]] In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], with Paratus out of the way, the Empire had conquered Raxus Prime, using its metals to construct new [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. In his attempt to disrupt Imperial activities, Starkiller was sent on a [[Second mission to Raxus Prime|mission]] to use an [[ore cannon]] to destroy an orbiting construction facility. However, one of the Star Destroyers survived, and descended to the surface. Starkiller attempted to flee, but there was little time, and [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] convinced him he had to destroy it. Using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Starkiller dragged the ship from the sky, and slammed it into the ground, destroying the ore cannon and many surrounding structures and junk formations. Meanwhile, the [[Core (Raxus Prime)|Core]], a super intelligent computer that functioned as a planet-wide intelligence of Raxus Prime, possessed Starkiller's holodroid, [[PROXY]]. The Core learned about the wider galaxy, and believing that [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was insufficient to bring order to chaos, decided that it was best suited for the job. It used PROXY and other droids to fight Starkiller in an attempt to escape Raxus Prime, but was defeated and destroyed by the Dark Jedi, who melted the Core's mainframe into slag, freeing PROXY in the process. In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Boba Fett returned to the planet to cull the weaklings from his new force of [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]] by pitting them against [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was [[Skirmish on Raxus Prime (25 ABY)|trapped]] there for a short period of time. ==Behind the scenes== According to the episode guide for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]," the relationship between Raxus Prime and the Separatist [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus]] has not been specified, though the two planets were intended to be different.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode310.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Heroes on Both Sides}} An explanation was eventually provided by the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]'', stating the two were located in the same star system. While exploring the planet in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'', remains of many iconic vehicles could be spotted in the junk, among them a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]], a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Lucrehulk-class battleship]], a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]], a [[Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter/Legends|Nantex-class territorial defense starfighter]], an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]], an [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]], a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], a [[YKL-37R Nova Courier]], a [[Separatist cruiser]], a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]], an [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]], an engine of a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]], the head of an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]], a [[Tsmeu-6 personal wheel bike]], a [[CR25 troop carrier/Legends|CR25 troop carrier]] and a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Venator-class Star Destroyer]]. A [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] can also be seen after using Force Grip to pull it out of the sludge near the start of the level. [[Adam Nichols]] created concept design of an unused faction known as the 'Smugglers' for the [[Krome Studios]] port of the [[2008]] video game ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]].'' Two of them wielding [[vibroblade]]s and another using an unused Heavy cannon. They were meant to be enemies towards the Rodion Salvager's Cartel and the player but were ultimate cut from the final game. {{WebCite|url=https://www.adamnichols.net/star_wars.php|text=Star Wars -
